_rules: Entries describe END-TO-END behaviors a user can observe, not implementation tasks.
Agents may ONLY change the 'passes' field. Removing or editing an entry is unacceptable: it hides missing functionality behind a shrinking definition of done.
Flip 'passes' to true only after verifying the behavior end to end, the way a user would. A green unit test is not the same as a working feature.
This file is JSON and not Markdown on purpose: models are measurably less likely to rewrite JSON they were told not to touch.
